summary:
Frontend-only validation of PPOS P3b (Client Dashboard OS), P3c (Specialist Mission Control) and P3d (Property Hub record page) on preview URL. Overall: PASS with 1 minor pre-existing UX regression (client v2-logout does not navigate to /login). All new presentation-layer testids render and behave per spec on both desktop 1920x900 and mobile 390x844. Detailed findings below.

P3b CLIENT DESKTOP (client@propmanage.io, 1920x900): v2-home-workspace present with 8+4 grid; main column shows v2-hero-c (activeReq) + v2-contextual ('Noutăți pentru tine') + v2-discover; right sticky column shows v2-property-status (clicking navigates to Property tab -> v2-property-view) + v2-copilot-card with v2-copilot-ask-ai (click triggers assistant, no error). v2-desktop-cta present on home when properties exist.

P3b CLIENT MOBILE (390x844): stack order verified by boundingRect top: hero-c(72) -> v2-contextual(353) -> v2-discover(540) -> v2-property-status(732) -> v2-copilot-card(830). v2-bottom-nav visible with 5 taburi + FAB central (v2-nav-request) which opens v2-wizard.

P3b ONBOARDING (new register p3b.onboard.{ts}@test.io on desktop 1920x900): route lands /client; DOM shows ONLY v2-home-onboarding + v2-hero-a ('Adaugă proprietatea'). v2-home-workspace=False, v2-contextual=False, v2-discover=False, v2-property-status=False, v2-copilot-card=False, v2-desktop-cta=False (hidden on home when no properties). Matches spec exactly.

P3c SPECIALIST DESKTOP (specialist@propmanage.io, 1920x900, VERIFIED tier): spec-workspace + spec-context-panel present & visible; KPIs spec-today-open/active/notifs/earnings all present & visible & clickable (each has onClick to scroll/setTab). spec-progress-card single instance present. Pipeline/cockpit testids ABSENT (correct for VERIFIED). accept-{id} button opens schedule-proposal-modal (schedule-close/start/end/hours/note/submit all present). Tab switches spec-tab-opportunities/jobs/notifications/settings all found via data-testid, plus desktop dock variants spec-tab-desktop-*.

P3c SPECIALIST MOBILE (390x844): spec-today KPIs at top≈323-422 render BEFORE specialist-leads list at top=1038 (KPIs first, as required). bottom-nav visible, bottom-nav-desktop hidden. Desktop viewport confirms inverse: bottom-nav hidden, bottom-nav-desktop visible.

P3d PROPERTY HUB DESKTOP (client 1920x900): hub-subnav renders 5 sections (rezumat/carte/twin/istoric/pasaport) + 2 secondary links (hub-subnav-wallet, hub-subnav-manage). Right sticky panel hub-context-panel wraps hub-status-panel with score + next-step. Section visibility verified: section=rezumat -> dna-card visible, vault-card hidden; section=carte -> vault-card visible, dna-card hidden; section=twin -> maturity-card+assets-card+dna-attributes-card visible + v2-hub-twin-desktop + v2-hub-health-desktop links visible; section=istoric -> risks-card visible + v2-hub-timeline-desktop link; section=pasaport -> passport-card + passport-status/qr/share/copy/etc visible. hub-status-next-step click correctly switches to 'carte' section (vault-card becomes visible).

P3d PROPERTY HUB MOBILE (client 390x844): hub-subnav & hub-context-panel PRESENT in DOM but NOT visible (lg:hidden gating correct). All cards visible stacked: dna-card, vault-card, passport-card, maturity-card, risks-card, assets-card, dna-attributes-card. Mobile quick-access list present: v2-hub-twin/health/timeline/wallet/manage.

REGRESSION CHECKS: v2-hero-c active-work hero rendered for client with running request (spec 'Plătește avansul (escrow)' path covered via HeroC logic). vault-add-btn opens vault-upload-sheet on mobile. v2-prop-selector only shown when properties.length>1 (default client has 1 prop -> selector hidden; not a regression). v2-desktop-nav toggles Acasă/Lucrări/Proprietăți/Setări correctly. Settings tab shows beta-feedback-open + v2-logout. Cookie banner dismissible with cookie-accept-all. Register + login flow functional.

MINOR ISSUE (pre-existing, not new): clicking v2-logout hits POST /api/auth/logout -> 200 {ok:true} and clears session cookie, but the app does NOT navigate to /login (URL stays /client and page shows an empty skeleton because /api/auth/me now returns 401). Same behavior observed on desktop and mobile. Root cause: auth.js logout() calls setUser(false) but ClientDashboardV2 does not call navigate('/login') after logout, unlike SettingsPanel.jsx line 370, AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx and PartnerDashboard.jsx which do 'await logout(); navigate("/login")'. Refresh recovers because ProtectedRoute kicks in. Not a P3b/c/d regression — the missing navigate has been there since V2 dashboard shipped and iteration_140 didn't catch it because it only asserted 'logout functional' (endpoint call).

ui_bugs.issue: v2-logout button calls logout() but does not navigate('/login') — page stays on /client with an empty skeleton until user refreshes. SettingsPanel.jsx / AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx / PartnerDashboard.jsx all correctly chain 'await logout(); navigate("/login")' — apply the same pattern in /app/frontend/src/pages/clientv2/ClientDashboardV2.jsx around line 208.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/clientv2/ClientDashboardV2.jsx replace `onClick={logout}` on v2-logout with `onClick={async () => { await logout(); navigate('/login'); }}` (add useNavigate import) so client V2 logout redirects to /login like the other dashboards.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientDashboardV2.jsx v2-logout handler is a bare `logout` reference — missing post-logout navigation. Aligning with SettingsPanel.jsx/AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx pattern would remove the stale-skeleton state that appears after logout.

HomeV2 initial mount briefly renders without workspace testids until /api/client/opportunities + /api/client/copilot + /api/properties/{id}/completeness settle (~2s). Consider a HomeSkeleton bridge to avoid a flash of empty right rail — cosmetic, not blocking.

PropertyHubV2 sec() uses `lg:hidden` to gate visibility on desktop; on mobile all sections mount simultaneously (heavier initial paint). Fine functionally but a future optimisation could lazy-render off-screen sections.

success_rate.frontend: ≈97% — all P3b/P3c/P3d specifications verified: onboarding gate, workspace 8+4, right context panel + copilot ask-ai, mobile stack order, spec Mission Control KPIs + context panel, VERIFIED tier hides pipeline cockpit, accept-{id} -> schedule modal, tab switching, Property Hub record page sub-nav + section visibility + hub-status-next-step, mobile stack unchanged (sub-nav & panel hidden). Only deviation: client v2-logout missing navigate('/login') (see ui_bugs).

test_credentials: Used client@propmanage.io/Client123!, specialist@propmanage.io/Spec123!, plus new register p3b.onboard.{ts}@test.io/Test1234! (created 1 TEST_ user for onboarding verification).
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_ user registered via /register (p3b.onboard.<epoch>@test.io) — no property/document/request created. Also 1 TEST_QA Spec Rec opportunity accepted-attempt on specialist (modal opened but not submitted, so no real acceptance / no 45 RON fee charged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: P3b/P3c/P3d presentation layer verified end-to-end on preview. Reliable testids: v2-home-workspace, v2-home-onboarding, v2-hero-a/b/c/doc, v2-contextual, v2-discover, v2-property-status, v2-copilot-card, v2-copilot-ask-ai, v2-desktop-cta, v2-desktop-nav-{home|jobs|property|settings}, v2-nav-{home|jobs|request|property|settings}, v2-bottom-nav, spec-workspace, spec-context-panel, spec-today-{open|active|notifs|earnings}, spec-progress-card, spec-tab-{opportunities|jobs|notifications|settings}(-desktop), accept-{oppId} -> schedule-proposal-modal, hub-subnav + hub-subnav-{rezumat|carte|twin|istoric|pasaport|wallet|manage}, hub-context-panel, hub-status-panel, hub-status-score, hub-status-next-step, dna-card, vault-card, passport-card, maturity-card, risks-card, assets-card, dna-attributes-card, v2-hub-{twin|health|timeline|wallet|manage}(-desktop). Only outstanding issue: v2-logout redirect missing (see action_items).
rca of the issue: v2-logout: `<button onClick={logout} data-testid="v2-logout">` in ClientDashboardV2.jsx line 208 wires the raw context logout() (which does POST /api/auth/logout + setUser(false)) but never calls navigate('/login'). Because the ProtectedRoute wrapper does not re-evaluate on the same route with the user going from truthy to false without a mount cycle, the URL stays /client. Fix: pass an inline handler that awaits logout then navigates — pattern already used in SettingsPanel.jsx:370, AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx:708, PartnerDashboard.jsx:97.
